content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 — GPU queue growth exceeded 5x baseline in us-west-2, autoscaler failed to create new MIG slices (scale_rejects: 84) - triggering page to on-call. Thread opened.
pagerduty: Paging ben_oncall (oncall).
ben_oncall: I’m on it. Seeing a bunch of 429/503s reported by the API gateway too. Any initial triage?
clara_runtime: Looking at tracer and autoscaler logs now. Early read: autoscaler attempted to allocate 16 new slices but rejected with "scale_request rejected: pool_fragmentation, insufficient contiguous slots". Queue backlog is ~6k requests, processing rate halved.
diego_infra: Confirming. Node-level view shows many partially used MIG instances with leftover fractional GPU RAM (~20-30%) — binpacking gap across pools.
maya_support: We already have customer reports: AcmePay and FinMap reporting token truncation and high latency. Support ticket IDs: #INC-7981, #INC-7982. Informing customers now (short note).
ben_oncall: Can we open a temporary dedicated burst pool? Any quick knobs?
clara_runtime: Two fast options: 1) manual repack to consolidate small slices into full-capacity nodes (will cause ~100 ephemeral job restarts) — medium risk but immediate capacity. 2) Increase per-pool max_slices limit and let autoscaler force-create new slices — but we hit GPU quota at cloud account level, so cloud API returns 403 for new instances.
diego_infra: Also observed autoscaler errors: 
```
ERROR autoscaler.go:412 scale_request rejected: pool_fragmentation (need contiguous 3x1g slices)
WARN allocator.go:157 cannot pack pod id=gen-req-21: insufficient mig-slice type=1g
```
ben_oncall: Are we able to temporarily re-route low-priority customers to cached responses / degraded mode?
clara_runtime: Yes — we can flip routing to fallback-models for non-SLA customers via traffic policy. That will drop cost/latency for those flows. Proposed immediate mitigations:
- Step A: Route all non-enterprise traffic through cached small-model (fallback) (clara) — <5m flip.
- Step B: Kick an on-demand manual repack job to consolidate stranded slices (diego + clara) — ~10-25m impact window.
- Step C: Contact cloud-ops to request emergency quota bump for us-west-2 (diego) — parallel.
- Step D: Support message to affected customers with ETA and workaround (maya) — immediate.
ben_oncall: Do it. Execute A and D first. Update when repack plan ready.
maya_support: Support message sent to AcmePay and FinMap: "We're actively mitigating GPU capacity constraints; some requests may see degraded performance. Estimated mitigation in ~20-30m. We will follow up"
clara_runtime: Flipped routing for non-SLA -> fallback model. Non-enterprise queue dropped by ~40% almost immediately.
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-rule/fallback-toggle by clara_runtime at 3998880060.
ben_oncall: Nice. What's the status on repack?
diego_infra: Repack plan: create ephemeral repack nodes in a separate pool, cordon underutilized nodes, migrate workloads (best-effort) and drain gaps, then delete empty nodes. This consolidates to fewer nodes with larger contiguous free space. Command sequence: 
```sh
# label nodes for repack
kubectl label node <node> redwood/repack=true
# run repack controller job
kubectl apply -f repack-job-rebalance.yaml
```
Risk: ~6% chance of job restarts and short-lived 10-30s GPU re-inits per affected pod.
clara_runtime: I'm running the controller with conservative batching (5 at a time). Watch autoscaler logs for further rejections.
ben_oncall: Proceed. Assign two people on repack: diego + clara. Kelsey, can you shadow for platform approvals?
kelsey_platform: I'm watching. If repack fails we fallback to manual eviction policy and escalate to cloud vendor.
clara_runtime: Repack job kicked at 3998880200. First batch of 5 nodes draining.
ben_oncall: Noted. ETA?
diego_infra: First batch drain complete, freed ~4 full slices. Queue backlog reduced by ~22%. But autoscaler still rejects scale requests for larger contiguous placements — hit a different pool with fragmentation.
clara_runtime: Rolling next batch. Also throttling low-priority connections at ingress to avoid queue amplification.
ben_oncall: Any customer-visible errors improving?
maya_support: AcmePay reports reduced 429s, but FinMap still seeing spikes. Sent targeted fallback instructions to FinMap engineering.
raj_cs: Notifying top accounts that we have live mitigation in progress and that we expect a full return to normal in ~45m. Will offer credits if SLA violated.
clara_runtime: Autoscaler output now shows intermittent cloud quota 403 on new instance create. We are partially blocked from scaling up programmatically.
diego_infra: Cloud-ops responded: we have a soft quota at account level; their automated process can grant emergency bump but needs manual approval — pinging channel.
ben_oncall: Kelsey, can you open the emergency cloud request ticket and PM the vendor contact?
kelsey_platform: Done. Ticket #CLOUD-2311 opened with vendor with high priority. Vendor acknowledged, setting to expedite.
ben_oncall: Good. Continue repack and keep rerouting. If we can free ~12 contiguous slices, we should absorb the backlog.
clara_runtime: Current metrics: backlog 2.1k -> 1.1k since repack start; processing rate up 38%. CPU/GPU metrics show reduced fragmentation but still ~6 awkward half-used nodes.
diego_infra: Pushing second-phase: targeted eviction of ephemeral batch jobs older than 2h (low pri) to free contiguous RAM. Implementing now.
clara_runtime: Also enabling KV prefix caching for some high-throughput routes to drop token generation load — gives us additional headroom.
ben_oncall: Any signs of memory leaks or KV cache thrash that could be making fragmentation worse?
clara_runtime: Not seeing leaks. This is pure placement binpacking fragmentation after a burst of mixed-shape jobs. Need longer term: smarter compaction policy + proactive repack scheduling.
ben_oncall: Understood. For P0 postmortem: action items now = 1) improve repacker heuristics (eng-runtime), 2) autoscaler to detect fragmentation and proactively repack before hitting queue thresholds, 3) add cloud quota pre-warming alerts (eng-infra), 4) customer routing controls per-tier (product).
kelsey_platform: Captured. Will open follow-ups and assign owners.
clara_runtime: Final update: repack complete at 3998881200. Freed ~14 contiguous slices. Backlog now ~420, processing rate ~90% baseline. Autoscaler able to create 4 additional slices (after vendor bump).
ben_oncall: Good job everyone. Keeping this thread open for post-incident notes. Will file incident ticket and start pager rota handover notes.
maya_support: I’ll follow up with affected customers and update tickets.
ben_oncall: Handoff to Kelsey for follow-up and postmortem. I’m taking a short break.
kelsey_platform: Taking ownership for follow-up. Please add logs and timeline to the incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident P0 resolved-ish: degraded -> recovering. Create incident report: /incidents/create 3998880000.
ben_oncall: :thumbsup: closing timeline updates. Thanks team.
